title: Serre vanishing for restricted projective-space twists over a Noetherian ring
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], N a natural number, and i:X→P^N_A a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let F be a quasi-coherent module of finite presentation on X [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine]. There exists a natural number t0 such that H^p(X,F tensor i^*O(t)) is zero for every p>0 and t>=t0, with module cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology], tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and the projective-space twists [def-pc-projective-space-twist].

source.place: Tags 01YS (2),(4) and 0B5T, preliminary closed-immersion comparison and proof of (4); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YS and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B5T read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Projective space over the Noetherian ring A is locally Noetherian by its finite type structure morphism. Apply isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion and isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion to G=i_*F. These give the exact two predicates required by the finite-twist presentation theorem; the full closed-immersion coherent equivalence is unnecessary.

Prove the nonnegative-twist vanishing clause of projective-space twist cohomology over arbitrary commutative rings within this module. Adapt the explicit source-library monomial-to-Cech comparison from TwistSections, using ((GammaSpecIso A).inv followed by the structure morphism appTop).hom for scalars. The existing bijective_sum_twistMonomialSection and twist_presheaf_map_twistMonomialSection work over CommRing; assemble their components and prove the alternating differential formula. Affine Cech comparison and restrictionScalarsHomologyIso identify ordinary H with the monomial complex homology. Its ring-general exactAt_monomialCechComplex kills middle degrees, subsingleton_monomialCechComplex_homology_top kills the positive top degree for nonnegative twists, and subsingleton_H_of_lt kills degrees above N. No field-only twist-cohomology declaration is applied. The five private compatibility lemmas explicitly bind CommRing coefficients; the corresponding existing source lemmas all bind Field coefficients and cannot be applied at this generality.

Prove ring-general Serre vanishing by induction on j for all quasi-coherent finitely presented modules G simultaneously, with vanishing for degrees q>0 satisfying N<q+j. For j=0 use the cohomological degree bound. In the successor step choose a finite negative-twist epimorphism f onto G with quasi-coherent finitely presented kernel. Take the maximum of the induction bounds for G and kernel f and a bound on the summand exponents. Where N<q+j, retain the induction bound for G. Otherwise twist the kernel short exact sequence by O(d); the explicit inverse O(-d) makes tensorRight O(d) an equivalence and therefore exact. Finite coproduct preservation and nonnegative-twist vanishing kill the middle term in degree q, while induction kills the kernel in degree q+1. subsingleton_H_of_shortExact gives vanishing for G. At j=N+1 every positive q is covered.

Apply the private ring-general Serre theorem to i_*F. Convert its integer bound m0 to m0.toNat; t>=m0.toNat implies (t:Z)>=m0. The existing exists_moduleCohomology_source_comparison transfers ordinary-H subsingletonness to IsZero of module cohomology. Apply the projection formula isomorphism through moduleCohomology.mapIso to obtain vanishing for i_*(F tensor i^*O(t)). This twisted module is quasi-coherent. For the affine closed immersion the edge map is an isomorphism; its inverse additive equivalence transfers subsingletonness to H^p(X,F tensor i^*O(t)). ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton finishes with the same uniform natural bound.

from.place: steps 4-6: closed immersion, projection formula and projective-space vanishing; excludes the ample-embedding and residue-class steps

lean.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_moduleCohomology_tensor_twist_of_closedImmersion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {N : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ (p t : ℕ), 0 < p → t₀ ≤ t →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj
        (tensorObj F (ProjectiveSpace.twistRestrict i t)))
